description: List your workspace's priced calls, newest first: each one's id (what report_outcome takes to report it), function, cost, the price given and the inputs it was given for, and who sent it. Pass buyer_agent verified for only the calls whose buying agent proved who it was with an AgentID token. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

buyer_agent.description: verified: only calls whose buying agent proved who it was with an AgentID token. Defaults to all.

end_date.description: Only calls up to this time, ISO 8601.

function_id.description: Only calls priced by this function.

offset.description: Calls to skip. Defaults to 0, at most 1000000.

start_date.description: Only calls from this time on, ISO 8601.

name: list_usage_events
